# Feature Request

Complete the sections that are relevant to your suggestion. You may remove optional sections that do not apply, but please clearly explain the requested feature, why it would be useful, and how you expect it to work.

> [!NOTE]
> Before submitting, please review [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/ZeroTraceAPI/Vector-Click/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md). Bug reports and feature requests do not require the pull-request Contribution agreement, but the guide explains reporting expectations, project scope, and how submissions are handled.

> [!CAUTION]
> Do not include private or sensitive information. Review screenshots, mockups, examples, and other attached files before submitting them.

## Area

Which part of Vector Click is this feature for?

Examples:

* Mouse or keyboard input
* Timing, repeat, or action behavior
* Targeting or application compatibility
* Safety, cleanup, or hotkeys
* Interface, display scaling, or accessibility
* Portable settings or privacy behavior
* Documentation or repository
* Other / Not sure

---

## Describe the feature

What would you like to see added or improved?

Explain the idea clearly. Include what the feature should do and how it could help.

---

## Problem or limitation

What issue, limitation, or inconvenience would this solve?

---

## Proposed solution

Describe how you think this feature could work.

---

## Alternatives considered

(Optional)

Have you considered any alternative solutions, settings, or workarounds?

---

## Use case

(Optional)

Describe when or why this feature would be useful.

---

## Environment, if relevant

(Optional)

* Operating system and version:
* System architecture:
* Compatibility layer / virtual machine, if applicable:
* Vector Click version / file name:
* Display resolution and scaling:
* Input method or target mode:
* Relevant Vector Click settings:

---

## Screenshots, mockups, or examples

(Optional)

Add screenshots, mockups, references, examples, or extra context if it helps explain the feature.

---

## Additional notes

Anything else that may help explain, evaluate, or understand the request.
